transcript:
User: Before you start your pitch — is this one of those AI robots? Be straight with me.
Agent: Yeah, it is — I’m Linda, an AI assistant on Jay’s team at Dialux, and I handle the intro questions and getting people to the right live walkthrough.  

Got it that you wanted me to be straight — so given that, what got you interested enough to call in today?
User: Great, a robot answering robots. Just put me down for a callback with a real human, and I'll talk then.
Agent: Gotcha, I hear you — you’d rather talk directly with a human.  

So I can get this to the right place, do you want Jay’s team to call you back on the number you’re using right now, and is there any specific topic you want them prepped on (missed calls, more leads, something else)?
User: Yes, have Jay's team call this number. I want to discuss options for a callback, no specific topic.
Agent: Got it, I’ll have Jay’s team give you a call back on this number to discuss options for a callback, nothing specific they need to prep in advance. If anything changes on your side, you can just ignore the call or call back in later. Thanks for taking a minute with me today — have a good one.
